#!/usr/bin/env bash
# devbox system bootstrap (root, idempotent; agentq ADR 0007). Installs:
#   * gh, age, sops, pwsh, acl (setfacl) system tools
#   * agentq system-wide in /opt/agentq (from the agentq checkout passed as $1, default /work/agentq) with
#     /usr/local/bin/agentq (per-user CLI: user store ~/.codai/coord + system store /var/lib/agentq)
#   * /usr/local/sbin/devbox-teams (users / repo groups / /work/<repo> 2770 / system store)
#   * agentq-sweep.timer: root sweep of stale leases every 10 min (system agentq)
# Usage: sudo bash devbox-root.sh [/path/to/agentq-checkout]
set -euo pipefail
SRC="${1:-/work/agentq}"
[ -d "$SRC/ps/bin" ] || SRC=/work/gh/agentq
T=$(mktemp -d)
if ! command -v gh >/dev/null; then
  curl -fsSLo "$T/gh.gpg" https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
  install -m 0644 "$T/gh.gpg" /usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg
  echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list
  apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq gh
fi
for p in age acl python3; do dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || apt-get install -y -qq "$p"; done
if ! command -v sops >/dev/null; then
  v=3.13.3; curl -fsSLo "$T/sops" "https://github.com/getsops/sops/releases/download/v$v/sops-v$v.linux.amd64"; install -m 0755 "$T/sops" /usr/local/bin/sops
fi
if ! command -v pwsh >/dev/null; then
  . /etc/os-release
  curl -fsSLo "$T/ms.deb" "https://packages.microsoft.com/config/ubuntu/${VERSION_ID}/packages-microsoft-prod.deb"
  dpkg -i "$T/ms.deb" >/dev/null && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq powershell
fi
rm -rf "$T"
# /work root-owned: team repos inside are 2770 per group; nobody but root can rename/replace one
mkdir -p /work && chown root:root /work && chmod 0755 /work
getent group devbox-users >/dev/null || groupadd devbox-users
id dev >/dev/null 2>&1 && usermod -aG devbox-users dev

# --- agentq system install (root-owned code: users run it, nobody but root changes it)
install -d -m 0755 /opt/agentq/bin
cp -f "$SRC"/ps/bin/*.ps1 "$SRC"/ps/bin/*.mjs "$SRC"/ps/bin/agentq-config.json /opt/agentq/bin/ 2>/dev/null || true
install -m 0755 "$SRC/ps/bin/devbox-teams.py" /usr/local/sbin/devbox-teams
chown -R root:root /opt/agentq && chmod -R a+rX,go-w /opt/agentq
cat > /usr/local/bin/agentq <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# agentq on the devbox: per-user store ~/.codai/coord + system store /var/lib/agentq (ADR 0007)
exec pwsh -NoProfile -File /opt/agentq/bin/agentq.ps1 "$@"
EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/agentq
cat > /etc/profile.d/agentq.sh <<'EOF'
# per-user files stay private (u=rwx); repo trees get group rw from their setgid dir + default ACL
umask 0007
export CODAI_WT_ROOT=/work/.wt
EOF

# --- system sweep: stale leases of every user (root reads every user's job registry)
cat > /etc/systemd/system/agentq-sweep.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=agentq system sweep (stale workspace leases, all users)
[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment=HOME=/root
Environment=CODAI_WT_ROOT=/work/.wt
ExecStart=/usr/bin/pwsh -NoProfile -File /opt/agentq/bin/agentq.ps1 sweep
Nice=10
EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/agentq-sweep.timer <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=agentq system sweep every 10 min
[Timer]
OnBootSec=5min
OnUnitActiveSec=10min
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now agentq-sweep.timer >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo ROOT_TOOLS_OK "$(gh --version | head -1)" "$(sops --version 2>/dev/null | head -1)" "pwsh $(pwsh -v 2>/dev/null)" "agentq $(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# devbox per-user bootstrap (runs AS the person, e.g. `dev`; agentq ADR 0007). Git-first: repos come from
# GitHub, secrets from sops+age, .git is never file-synced. Clones into /work/<repo> only when the repo does
# not exist yet (a repo already shared by the team is used as-is: access = membership of r-<repo>).
#   REPOS="owner/repo=folder ..." [AGE_KEY_B64=...] [GH_TOKEN=...] bash devbox-user.sh
set -euo pipefail
REPOS="${REPOS:-codai axiom agentq}"
WORK="${WORK:-/work}"
umask 0007
mkdir -p ~/.config/sops/age ~/.codai/coord
chmod 700 ~/.config ~/.codai

for t in gh sops age git; do command -v "$t" >/dev/null || { echo "missing $t (run devbox-root.sh as root)"; exit 2; }; done

# secrets key (passed once, base64, never echoed) - private to this user
if [ -n "${AGE_KEY_B64:-}" ]; then (umask 077; echo "$AGE_KEY_B64" | base64 -d > ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt); fi
grep -q 'SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE' ~/.profile 2>/dev/null || echo 'export SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE=$HOME/.config/sops/age/keys.txt' >> ~/.profile
export SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE=$HOME/.config/sops/age/keys.txt

# GitHub auth (token from the caller's gh, never written to a repo; gh refuses login while GH_TOKEN is exported)
if [ -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then _t="$GH_TOKEN"; unset GH_TOKEN; echo "$_t" | gh auth login --with-token; unset _t; gh auth setup-git; fi
git config --global pull.ff only
git config --global fetch.prune true
git config --global core.autocrlf input

for r in $REPOS; do
  folder=""; case "$r" in *=*) folder="${r#*=}"; r="${r%%=*}";; esac
  case "$r" in */*) full="$r";; codai) full=codai-ro/codai-cc;; axiom) full=dragoscv/axiom;; agentq) full=dragos-catalin/agentq;; *) full="dragos-catalin/$r";; esac
  name="${folder:-$(basename "$r")}"
  d="$WORK/$name"
  [ -d "$d/.git" ] || { [ -d "$WORK/gh/$name/.git" ] && d="$WORK/gh/$name"; }
  if [ ! -d "$d/.git" ]; then gh repo clone "$full" "$d" -- --filter=blob:none -q
  elif [ -r "$d/.git/HEAD" ]; then git -C "$d" fetch -q --all || true
  else echo "repo $name: no access (not in group r-$name)"; continue; fi
  # restore encrypted secrets next to their originals (secrets/<rel>.enc -> <rel>), only when the key exists
  if [ -d "$d/secrets" ] && [ -s ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt ]; then
    (cd "$d" && find secrets -name '*.enc' -type f | while read -r f; do rel="${f#secrets/}"; rel="${rel%.enc}"; [ -e "$rel" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$rel")"; sops --decrypt --input-type json --output-type binary --output "$rel" "$f" && chmod 660 "$rel"; }; done)
  fi
  echo "repo $full -> $d ($(git -C "$d" rev-parse --short HEAD))"
done
echo DEVBOX_BOOTSTRAP_OK

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Done-means 5: a member without access to a repo cannot read it, nor can processes ("agents") they start.
# Test account u-7e570001 = member of r-agentq only (applied through devbox-teams with a test desired state,
# then the real state from /etc/agentq/teams.json is re-applied so the box ends exactly as the hub says).
set -u
T=u-7e570001
pass=0; fail=0
ok() { echo "PASS $1"; pass=$((pass+1)); }
ko() { echo "FAIL $1"; fail=$((fail+1)); }
real=/tmp/teams-real.json
cp /etc/agentq/teams.json "$real"   # apply rewrites /etc/agentq/teams.json: keep the hub state aside
sig=$(head -c 24 /work/agentq/.gitattributes)
python3 - "$real" "$T" > /tmp/teams-test.json <<'EOF'
import json, sys
d = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
d["repos"].setdefault("agentq", {"members": []})["members"].append({"linux": sys.argv[2], "role": "developer"})
print(json.dumps(d))
EOF
devbox-teams apply --file /tmp/teams-test.json | tail -1
id "$T" >/dev/null && ok "account $T created by devbox-teams" || ko "account $T"
as() { sudo -u "$T" -H bash -lc "$1" 2>&1; }
# allowed repo
[ "$(as 'head -c 24 /work/agentq/.gitattributes')" = "$sig" ] && ok "member reads /work/agentq" || ko "member reads /work/agentq: $(as 'head -c 80 /work/agentq/.gitattributes')"
as 'cd /work/agentq && git status --porcelain | wc -l' | grep -qE '^[0-9]+$' && ok "member runs git in /work/agentq" || ko "git in agentq: $(as 'cd /work/agentq && git status 2>&1 | head -2')"
as 'touch /work/agentq/.copilot-tmp-isotest && stat -c "%G %a" /work/agentq/.copilot-tmp-isotest && rm /work/agentq/.copilot-tmp-isotest' | grep -q '^r-agentq 66' && ok "new file inherits r-agentq, group rw, no other" || ko "file mode: $(as 'touch /work/agentq/.x; stat -c "%G %a" /work/agentq/.x; rm -f /work/agentq/.x')"
# forbidden repo, from the shell
as 'ls /work/codai' | grep -qi 'permission denied' && ok "ls /work/codai denied" || ko "ls /work/codai: $(as 'ls /work/codai | head -2')"
as 'cat /work/codai/package.json' | grep -qi 'permission denied' && ok "read /work/codai file denied" || ko "read codai file"
as 'cat /work/gh/codai/package.json' | grep -qi 'permission denied' && ok "old path /work/gh/codai denied too" || ko "old path"
as 'git -C /work/codai log -1' | grep -qiE 'permission denied|not a git' && ok "git on codai denied" || ko "git codai"
as 'mv /work/codai /work/codai-x' | grep -qi 'denied' && [ -d /work/codai ] && ok "cannot rename/replace a team repo" || ko "rename /work/codai"
# forbidden repo, from a child process the member starts (stand-in for their agent: node + pwsh)
as 'node -e "require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"/work/codai/package.json\")"' | grep -q EACCES && ok "agent (node child) cannot read codai" || ko "node child"
as 'pwsh -NoProfile -c "Get-Content /work/codai/package.json"' | grep -qiE 'denied|unauthorized' && ok "agent (pwsh child) cannot read codai" || ko "pwsh child"
as 'nohup bash -c "cat /work/codai/package.json" > /tmp/iso-bg.out 2>&1; cat /tmp/iso-bg.out; rm -f /tmp/iso-bg.out' | grep -qi denied && ok "background job cannot read codai" || ko "bg job"
# system agentq: the codai journal and queues are closed to the member, agentq ones open
as 'cat /var/lib/agentq/journal.d/codai.jsonl' | grep -qi denied && ok "codai journal unreadable" || ko "codai journal"
as 'ls /var/lib/agentq/queues/build_codai' | grep -qi denied && ok "codai queue dir unreadable" || ko "codai queue"
as 'ls /var/lib/agentq/leases/codai' | grep -qi denied && ok "codai leases unreadable" || ko "codai leases"
as 'cd /work/codai 2>/dev/null; agentq run -Resource build -Repo /work/codai -Purpose isotest -MinFreeGB 0 -- true; echo RC=$?' | grep -q 'RC=[1-9]' && ok "agentq run on codai refused" || ko "agentq run codai"
out=$(as 'cd /work/agentq && agentq run -Resource build -Purpose isotest-agentq -MinFreeGB 0 -- true; echo RC=$?')
echo "$out" | grep -q 'RC=0' && ok "agentq run on agentq works (system queue)" || ko "agentq run agentq: $(echo "$out" | tail -3)"
grep -q isotest-agentq /var/lib/agentq/journal.d/agentq.jsonl && ok "event landed in journal.d/agentq.jsonl" || ko "agentq journal"
grep -q isotest-agentq /var/lib/agentq/journal.jsonl && ko "repo event leaked into the shared journal" || ok "repo event not in the shared journal"
# owner (dev) sees everything; per-user store is private
sudo -u dev -H bash -lc 'head -c1 /work/codai/package.json' >/dev/null 2>&1 && ok "owner dev reads codai" || ko "owner dev"
as 'ls /home/dev' | grep -qi denied && ok "member cannot read owner home (keys, .env)" || ko "home"
stat -c '%a' "/home/$T/.codai/coord" | grep -q '^700' && ok "per-user agentq store 0700" || ko "user store mode"
# offboard: removing the member (re-apply the real state) locks the account and drops access
devbox-teams apply --file "$real" | tail -1
[ "$(as 'head -c 24 /work/agentq/.gitattributes')" != "$sig" ] && ok "after removal: access gone ($(as 'head -c 24 /work/agentq/.gitattributes' | head -1 | cut -c1-60))" || ko "after removal: member still reads agentq"
id -nG "$T" | grep -q r-agentq && ko "after removal: still in r-agentq" || ok "after removal: not in r-agentq"
chage -l "$T" | grep -q 'Account expires.*1970' && ok "after removal: account expired, home kept ($(test -d /home/$T && echo yes))" || ko "expiry"
rm -f /tmp/teams-test.json "$real"
echo "ISOLATION pass=$pass fail=$fail"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]

  Runs every test suite against THIS checkout first; refuses to install on red. Keeps a timestamped
  backup of each file it replaces in ~/.copilot/.backup/<ts>/. -Check = report drift only.
#>
param([switch]$Check, [switch]$SkipTests)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$src = $PSScriptRoot
$map = [ordered]@{

  'tests\test-land-changelog.ps1' = 'bin\test-land-changelog.ps1'
  'bin\repo-migrate.ps1' = 'bin\repo-migrate.ps1'; 'tests\test-repo-migrate.ps1' = 'bin\test-repo-migrate.ps1'
  # background jobs: bounded wait + registry (mirrored by agentq-sync)
  'bin\agentq-jobs-lib.ps1' = 'bin\agentq-jobs-lib.ps1'; 'bin\wait-job.ps1' = 'bin\wait-job.ps1'; 'bin\job-start.ps1' = 'bin\job-start.ps1'
  'bin\job-run.ps1' = 'bin\job-run.ps1'; 'bin\jobs.ps1' = 'bin\jobs.ps1'; 'tests\test-jobs.ps1' = 'bin\test-jobs.ps1'

  'bin\git-autosync.ps1' = 'bin\git-autosync.ps1'; 'tests\test-git-autosync.ps1' = 'bin\test-git-autosync.ps1'; 'tests\test-guard-shared.ps1' = 'hooks\test-guard-shared.ps1'
  'bin\agentq-cloud.ps1' = 'bin\agentq-cloud.ps1'; 'tests\test-agentq-cloud.ps1' = 'bin\test-agentq-cloud.ps1'; 'tests\test-guard-cloud.ps1' = 'hooks\test-guard-cloud.ps1'

  'bin\reap-terminals.ps1' = 'bin\reap-terminals.ps1'; 'tests\test-agentq-adaptive.ps1' = 'bin\test-agentq-adaptive.ps1'
  # 2026-10-18: VS Code chat-terminal associations, so the reaper never interrupts an agent

  # ADR 0003 wave 1: publish, lease activity + notices + slot prep, PowerShell entry hardening

if ($Check) { if ($drift) { "DRIFT: $($drift -join ', ')"; exit 1 }; 'in sync'; exit 0 }
if (-not $SkipTests) {
  & pwsh -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $src 'tests\run-all.ps1')

  $a = Join-Path $src $k; $b = Join-Path $dst $map[$k]
  if (Test-Path $b) { $t = Join-Path $bk $map[$k]; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $t) | Out-Null; Copy-Item $b $t }
  # atomic replace: a hook firing mid-copy must never see half a file
  Copy-Item $a "$b.new" -Force; Move-Item "$b.new" $b -Force
  "installed $($map[$k])"
}
# legacy test that encoded the retired ad-hoc naming
$old = Join-Path $dst 'hooks\test-worktree-tools.ps1'
if (Test-Path $old) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $bk 'hooks') | Out-Null; Move-Item $old (Join-Path $bk 'hooks\test-worktree-tools.ps1') -Force; 'retired hooks\test-worktree-tools.ps1 (superseded by test-worktree-v2.ps1)' }
# ADR 0007: the WIP snapshot task runs the agentq copy (was ~/.codai/git/wip-all.ps1)
$wipTask = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'codai-git-wip-snapshot' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($wipTask -and "$($wipTask.Actions[0].Arguments)" -notmatch 'git-wip-snapshot\.ps1') {
  $a = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'pwsh.exe' -Argument "-NoProfile -NonInteractive -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$(Join-Path $dst 'bin\git-wip-snapshot.ps1')`" -All"
  Set-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'codai-git-wip-snapshot' -Action $a | Out-Null
  'task codai-git-wip-snapshot -> bin\git-wip-snapshot.ps1 -All'
}
"install: $($drift.Count) file(s); backup in $bk"

# Runs every ps/ test suite against THIS checkout (not the installed copy). Exit 0 only if all pass.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$bin = Join-Path $root 'bin'; $hooks = Join-Path $root 'hooks'
# test-agentq.ps1 resolves agentq.ps1 next to itself: run it from a temp copy beside bin/.
$stage = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('aq-runall-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 6))
New-Item -ItemType Directory $stage | Out-Null
Copy-Item (Join-Path $bin '*') $stage
Copy-Item (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-agentq.ps1') $stage
Copy-Item (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-agentq-v3.ps1') $stage
$suites = [ordered]@{
  'agentq v1'      = @('-File', (Join-Path $stage 'test-agentq.ps1'))
  'agentq v3'      = @('-File', (Join-Path $stage 'test-agentq-v3.ps1'))
  'agentq v2'      = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-agentq-v2.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'land changelog' = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-land-changelog.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'worktree v2'    = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-worktree-v2.ps1'), '-Bin', $bin, '-Hooks', $hooks)
  'repo-migrate'   = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-repo-migrate.ps1'), '-Tool', (Join-Path $bin 'repo-migrate.ps1'))
  'guard'          = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-guard-v2.ps1'), '-Guard', (Join-Path $hooks 'guard-tooluse.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'jobs'           = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-jobs.ps1'), '-Bin', $bin, '-Hooks', $hooks)
  'cloud place'    = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-agentq-cloud.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $stage 'agentq.ps1'))
  'adaptive+reg'   = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-agentq-adaptive.ps1'))
  'reap terminals' = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-reap-terminals.ps1'), '-Tool', (Join-Path $bin 'reap-terminals.ps1'))
  'term interrupt' = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-term-interrupt.ps1'), '-Tool', (Join-Path $bin 'term-interrupt.ps1'))
  'git-autosync'   = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-git-autosync.ps1'), '-Tool', (Join-Path $bin 'git-autosync.ps1'))
  'guard shared'   = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-guard-shared.ps1'), '-Guard', (Join-Path $hooks 'guard-tooluse.ps1'))
  'guard cloud'    = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-guard-cloud.ps1'), '-Guard', (Join-Path $hooks 'guard-tooluse.ps1'))
  # ADR 0003 wave 1
  'publish'        = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-agentq-publish.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'lease3+prep'    = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-agentq-lease3.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'args'           = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-agentq-args.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  # ADR 0003 wave 2/4
  'land finalize'  = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-land-finalize.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'land precheck'  = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-land-precheck.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'land reclaim'   = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-land-reclaim.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'job object'     = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-jobobject.ps1'), '-Bin', $bin)
  'flakes'         = @('-Command', "node '$(Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-flakes.mjs')'; if (`$LASTEXITCODE) { exit `$LASTEXITCODE } else { 'PASS flakes selftest' }")
  'land batch'     = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-land-batch.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'claims'         = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-agentq-claims.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'land flakes'    = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-land-flakes.ps1'), '-Aq', (Join-Path $bin 'agentq.ps1'))
  'store'          = @('-Command', "node '$(Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-store.mjs')'; if (`$LASTEXITCODE) { exit `$LASTEXITCODE } else { 'PASS store selftest' }")
  # ADR 0007: git-first + devbox teams
  'devbox tools'   = @('-File', (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-devbox-tools.ps1'), '-Bin', $bin)
  'devbox teams'   = @('-Command', "python '$(Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-devbox-teams.py')' '$(Join-Path $bin 'devbox-teams.py')' 2>&1; if (`$LASTEXITCODE) { 'FAIL devbox-teams planner'; exit `$LASTEXITCODE } else { 'PASS devbox-teams planner (16)' }")
  'slo'            = @('-Command', "node '$(Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'test-slo.mjs')'; if (`$LASTEXITCODE) { exit `$LASTEXITCODE } else { 'PASS slo selftest' }")
}
$bad = @()
foreach ($k in $suites.Keys) {
  $a = $suites[$k]
  if ($a[0] -eq '-File' -and -not (Test-Path $a[1])) { Write-Host "SKIP $k (missing $($a[1]))"; continue }
  $out = @(& pwsh -NoProfile @a 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" })
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  $fails = @($out | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*(FAIL)\b' })
  Write-Host ("{0,-15} exit={1} pass={2} fail={3}" -f $k, $code, @($out | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*(PASS|ok)\b' }).Count, $fails.Count)
  $fails | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "   $_" }
  if ($code) { $bad += $k }
}
cmd /c rmdir /s /q "`"$stage`"" 2>$null
if ($bad) { Write-Host "FAILED: $($bad -join ', ')"; exit 1 } else { Write-Host 'ALL SUITES PASS'; exit 0 }

# ADR 0007: git-first + devbox tools moved into agentq. Local fixtures only (bare remotes in TEMP, no GitHub,
# no ssh): git-publish / git-wip-snapshot / devsync plan / devbox-team-sync mapping / agentq workspace +
# system store. The planner of devbox-teams has its own suite (test-devbox-teams.py).
param([string]$Bin = (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..\bin'))
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$Bin = (Resolve-Path $Bin).Path
$tmp = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('aqdbx-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0, 6))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmp | Out-Null
$env:AGENTQ_HOME = Join-Path $tmp 'coord'; $env:CODAI_WT_ROOT = Join-Path $tmp 'wt'
$env:AGENTQ_NO_SIGNAL = '1'; $env:AGENTQ_NO_REGISTRY = '1'; $env:AGENTQ_SESSION = 'test-dbx'
$env:GIT_AUTHOR_NAME = 't'; $env:GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL = 't@t'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_NAME = 't'; $env:GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL = 't@t'
Remove-Item Env:AGENTQ_SYSTEM_HOME -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$fail = 0
function Check([string]$name, [bool]$ok, [string]$detail = '') { if ($ok) { Write-Host "PASS $name" } else { Write-Host "FAIL $name $detail" -ForegroundColor Red; $script:fail++ } }
function NewRepo([string]$name) {
  $bare = Join-Path $tmp "$name.git"; git init -q --bare -b main $bare
  $r = Join-Path $tmp $name; git init -q -b main $r
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $r 'a.txt'), "a`n"); git -C $r add -A; git -C $r commit -qm init
  git -C $r remote add origin $bare; git -C $r push -q origin main 2>$null
  $r
}
try {
  # ---- git-publish
  $r = NewRepo 'pub'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $r 'a.txt'), "changed`n")
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $r 'new.txt'), "new`n")
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $r 'node_modules\x') | Out-Null
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $r 'node_modules\x\i.js'), "junk`n")
  $headBefore = (git -C $r rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); $statusBefore = @(git -C $r status --porcelain) -join '|'
  $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $Bin 'git-publish.ps1') -Path $r -Branch 'wip/snap-test' -WtRoot (Join-Path $tmp 'nowt') 2>&1 | Out-String
  $snap = git -C (Join-Path $tmp 'pub.git') rev-parse --verify -q 'refs/heads/wip/snap-test'
  Check 'publish: snapshot branch pushed' ([bool]$snap) $o
  $files = if ($snap) { @(git -C (Join-Path $tmp 'pub.git') ls-tree -r --name-only $snap) } else { @() }
  Check 'publish: snapshot has the uncommitted files' (($files -contains 'new.txt') -and ((git -C (Join-Path $tmp 'pub.git') show "${snap}:a.txt") -eq 'changed'))
  Check 'publish: node_modules never committed' (-not ($files | Where-Object { $_ -like 'node_modules/*' }))
  Check 'publish: HEAD untouched' ((git -C $r rev-parse HEAD).Trim() -eq $headBefore)
  Check 'publish: .gitignore baseline + secrets un-ignore last' ((Get-Content (Join-Path $r '.gitignore') | Select-Object -Last 1) -eq '!secrets/**/*.enc')
  $o2 = & pwsh -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $Bin 'git-publish.ps1') -Path $r -Branch 'wip/snap-test' -WtRoot (Join-Path $tmp 'nowt') 2>&1 | Out-String
  $snap2 = git -C (Join-Path $tmp 'pub.git') rev-parse --verify -q 'refs/heads/wip/snap-test'
  Check 'publish: rerun fast-forwards (snapshot 1 is an ancestor)' ($snap2 -and ((git -C (Join-Path $tmp 'pub.git') merge-base --is-ancestor $snap $snap2) -or $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0)) $o2
  # secrets without an age key: refused, never committed in clear
  $r2 = NewRepo 'pubsec'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $r2 '.env'), "DEMO=1`n")   # detected by file name, content irrelevant
  $o3 = & pwsh -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $Bin 'git-publish.ps1') -Path $r2 -AgeKeyFile (Join-Path $tmp 'nokey.txt') -WtRoot (Join-Path $tmp 'nowt') 2>&1 | Out-String
  Check 'publish: .env without age key is refused' (($o3 -match 'no age key') -and -not (git -C (Join-Path $tmp 'pubsec.git') for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' 'refs/heads/wip')) $o3
  # active shared clone refused
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $tmp 'wt2\pub') | Out-Null
  $o4 = & pwsh -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $Bin 'git-publish.ps1') -Path $r -WtRoot (Join-Path $tmp 'wt2') 2>&1 | Out-String
  Check 'publish: active shared clone refused' ($o4 -match 'ACTIVE shared clone') $o4

  # ---- git-wip-snapshot
  $w = NewRepo 'wip'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $w 'a.txt'), "wip`n")
  $idxBefore = (Get-FileHash (Join-Path $w '.git\index')).Hash
  $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $Bin 'git-wip-snapshot.ps1') -Repo $w -HostName 'testhost' -AgeKeyFile (Join-Path $tmp 'nokey.txt') 2>&1 | Out-String
  $ref = git -C (Join-Path $tmp 'wip.git') rev-parse --verify -q 'refs/wip/testhost/main/latest'
  Check 'wip: ref pushed to private (non-GitHub) origin' ([bool]$ref) $o
  Check 'wip: index untouched' ((Get-FileHash (Join-Path $w '.git\index')).Hash -eq $idxBefore)
  Check 'wip: worktree change captured' ($ref -and (git -C (Join-Path $tmp 'wip.git') show "${ref}:a.txt") -eq 'wip')
  $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $Bin 'git-wip-snapshot.ps1') -Repo $w -HostName 'testhost' -AgeKeyFile (Join-Path $tmp 'nokey.txt') 2>&1 | Out-String
  Check 'wip: unchanged tree not pushed again' ($o -match 'unchanged') $o

  # ---- devsync plan: no .git, group-only modes
  $plan = @(& pwsh -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $Bin 'devsync.ps1') plan -Project codai -LocalRoot $tmp -RemoteHost h 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { "$_" })
  $pj = $plan -join ' '
  Check 'devsync: .git and node_modules ignored' (($pj -match '--ignore \.git ') -and ($pj -match '--ignore node_modules')) $pj
  Check 'devsync: remote files group-only (0660/2770)' (($pj -match 'default-file-mode-beta 0660') -and ($pj -match 'default-directory-mode-beta 2770')) $pj
  Check 'devsync: remote path /work/<repo>' ($pj -match 'h:/work/codai') $pj

  # ---- devbox-team-sync mapping (recorded hub snapshot, no HTTP)
  $snapFile = Join-Path $tmp 'hub.json'
  $hub = @{
    environments = @(
      @{ id = 'e1'; name = 'devbox:ws-devbox:codai'; state = 'pending'; ownerUserId = 'own' },
      @{ id = 'e2'; name = 'devbox:ws-devbox:axiom'; state = 'pending'; ownerUserId = 'own' },
      @{ id = 'e3'; name = 'unrelated env'; state = 'running'; ownerUserId = 'own' })
    members = @{
      e1 = @(@{ user_id = 'own'; role = 'owner'; linux_username = 'u-11111111' }, @{ user_id = 'ana'; role = 'developer'; linux_username = 'u-0f1d2c3e' }, @{ user_id = 'vic'; role = 'viewer'; linux_username = $null })
      e2 = @(@{ user_id = 'own'; role = 'owner'; linux_username = 'u-11111111' })
    }
    ca = @('ssh-ed25519 ' + ('A' * 68) + ' codai')
  }
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($snapFile, ($hub | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6))
  $dj = & pwsh -NoProfile -File (Join-Path $Bin 'devbox-team-sync.ps1') -FromFile $snapFile -DesiredOnly 2>&1 | Out-String
  $d = $dj | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
  Check 'team-sync: one repo per devbox env, unrelated env ignored' (($d.repos.Keys | Sort-Object) -join ',' -eq 'axiom,codai') $dj
  Check 'team-sync: env owner -> dev, member -> u-<8hex>' ((@($d.repos.codai.members | ForEach-Object { "$($_.linux):$($_.role)" }) -join ',') -eq 'dev:owner,u-0f1d2c3e:developer') $dj
  Check 'team-sync: no Linux account -> skipped' (-not ($dj -match 'vic')) $dj
  Check 'team-sync: CA key carried, no hub key in output' (($d.ca_keys.Count -eq 1) -and -not ($dj -match 'codai_[A-Za-z0-9]{8}|Bearer')) $dj
  # the desired state is accepted by devbox-teams' own validator
  $py = Join-Path $Bin 'devbox-teams.py'
  $vf = Join-Path $tmp 'v.py'
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($vf, "import importlib.util,sys,json`nspec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('d',sys.argv[1]);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);sys.modules['d']=m;spec.loader.exec_module(m)`nm.validate(json.load(open(sys.argv[2])));print('VALID')`n")
  $df = Join-Path $tmp 'd.json'; [IO.File]::WriteAllText($df, $dj)
  $v = & python $vf $py $df 2>&1 | Out-String
  Check 'team-sync: desired state passes devbox-teams validate' ($v -match 'VALID') $v

  # ---- agentq workspace verb (single store) + system store routing
  $Aq = Join-Path $Bin 'agentq.ps1'
  $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File $Aq workspace take -Name codai -Purpose 'test take' 2>&1 | Out-String
  Check 'workspace: take' ($o -match 'workspace codai active at') $o
  $env:AGENTQ_CLIENT_HOST = 'otherpc'
  $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File $Aq workspace take -Name codai -Purpose 'second' 2>&1 | Out-String; $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
  Check 'workspace: second holder refused (exit 3)' ($rc -eq 3 -and $o -match 'ACTIVE at') "rc=$rc $o"
  $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File $Aq workspace release -Name codai 2>&1 | Out-String; $rc = $LASTEXITCODE
  Check 'workspace: non-holder cannot release' ($rc -eq 3) "rc=$rc $o"
  Remove-Item Env:AGENTQ_CLIENT_HOST
  $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File $Aq workspace list 2>&1 | Out-String
  Check 'workspace: list shows holder' ($o -match 'codai' -and $o -match 'test take') $o
  $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File $Aq workspace release -Name codai 2>&1 | Out-String
  Check 'workspace: holder releases' ($o -match 'released') $o
  # system store: queues/journal go to AGENTQ_SYSTEM_HOME, the user store keeps only private state
  $sys = Join-Path $tmp 'sys'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $sys 'journal.d') | Out-Null
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $sys 'journal.d\sysrepo.jsonl'), '')
  $env:AGENTQ_SYSTEM_HOME = $sys
  $sr = NewRepo 'sysrepo'
  Push-Location $sr
  try { $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File $Aq run -Resource build -Purpose 'sys store run' -MinFreeGB 0 '--' git status 2>&1 | Out-String } finally { Pop-Location }
  $repoJ = Get-Content (Join-Path $sys 'journal.d\sysrepo.jsonl') -Raw
  Check 'system: repo events in journal.d/<repo>.jsonl' ($repoJ -match 'sys store run') $o
  Check 'system: queue dirs in the system store' (Test-Path (Join-Path $sys 'queues\build_sysrepo'))
  Check 'system: nothing repo-scoped in the user store' (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $env:AGENTQ_HOME 'queues\build_sysrepo')))
  $o = & pwsh -NoProfile -File $Aq log -Repo $sr -Last 20 2>&1 | Out-String
  Check 'system: log reads the repo journal' ($o -match 'sys store run') $o
  Remove-Item Env:AGENTQ_SYSTEM_HOME
} finally { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
if ($fail) { "FAILED $fail"; exit 1 } else { 'ALL OK'; exit 0 }
